items.text: The Police's "Every Breath You Take" spent eight weeks at number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1983, the year's longest run at the top.
items.question: Where were you living when "Every Breath You Take" was number one, and who in your house played it most?
source_quote: The Billboard Hot 100 is a chart published since August 1958 by Billboard magazine which ranks the best-performing singles in the United States. In 1983, it was compiled based on a combination of sales and airplay data sourced from surveys of retail outlets and playlists submitted by radio stations, respectively. During the year, 17 different singles spent time at number one.

Another British group, the Police, reached number one in the United States for the first time with "Every Breath You Take", which spent eight weeks in the peak position, the year's longest run atop the Hot 100.

items.text: On June 18, 1983, Sally Ride became the first American woman in space, aboard the Space Shuttle Challenger.
items.question: Do you remember hearing that Sally Ride had gone into space, and where were you when you heard?
items.source_quote: June 18 – STS-7: Sally Ride becomes the first American woman in space, on the Space Shuttle Challenger.
